sections.heading: About Governing Council
content: The Government of Andhra Pradesh established Rajiv Gandhi University of Knowledge Technologies (RGUKT) in 2008 to cater to the educational needs of the meritorious rural youth of Andhra Pradesh. Four Institutions (IIITs) are established under RGUKT, one each at Nuzivid (Krishna dt), Rajiv Knowledge Valley (Kadapa dt), Ongole and Srikakulam. These autonomous Institutions will specialize in teaching and research in Information Technology and other emerging engineering and other disciplines under the control of a common University Governing Council and following a common syllabus.

sections.heading: Prof. K. Madhu Murthy
content: Prof. (Dr.) Kotha Madhu Murthy assumed charge as Chancellor (FAC) on 18.04.2025. An accomplished academician and administrator, he is currently serving as the Chairman of the Andhra Pradesh State Council of Higher Education (APSCHE). With over 37 years of experience in Mechanical Engineering and Entrepreneurship, he has made significant contributions to higher education policy, research, and institutional development.

Prior to his current role, Prof. Murthy was a Professor (HAG) in the Department of Mechanical Engineering at the National Institute of Technology, Warangal (NITW), where he also served as a Member of the Board of Governors . His leadership roles at NITW included Dean (Faculty Welfare), Head of the Mechanical Engineering Department, and Registrar (Additional Charge). He also held the position of Registrar at NIT Delhi.

Prof. Murthy holds a Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering from Regional Engineering College, Warangal (now NITW), an M.Tech. in IC Engines & Gas Turbines, a B.E. in Mechanical Engineering, and a PG Diploma in Business Administration. His research expertise encompasses IC engines, biofuels, solar energy, and rocket propellants, with numerous publications in reputed journals.

Beyond academia, he has contributed to national policy as an Advisor at the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), focusing on policy formulation, governance restructuring, and curriculum reforms. Internationally, he served as a LEDA Management Advisor for UNDP/ILO in Cambodia and collaborated with Samsung India Software Organization on HR and training initiatives.

A Fellow of The Institution of Engineers (India), Andhra Pradesh Akademi of Sciences, and the Indian Institution of Production Engineers, Prof. Murthy has been instrumental in entrepreneurship and skill development initiatives, establishing incubation centers, and enhancing campus placements. His accolades include the British Council TCTP Fellowship (1996) under the Indo-UK RECs Project, four Best Paper Awards, and a Lifetime Achievement Recognition for his impact on engineering education and entrepreneurship development.

As Chairman of APSCHE, Prof. Murthy is spearheading reforms in higher education policy, academic innovation, and industry-academia collaboration, aiming to build a robust, future-ready education system in Andhra Pradesh.

sections.heading: Prof. Amarendra Kumar Sandra
content: Dr. Amarendra Kumar Sandra is a highly accomplished academician and researcher with extensive expertise in transportation engineering and civil engineering. He holds a Ph.D. in Transportation Engineering from Birla Institute of Technology and Science (BITS), Pilani, Rajasthan, completed in April 2008. He earned his M.Tech. in Transportation Engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Kharagpur, and TU-Darmstadt, Germany, in March 2003, where he was awarded the prestigious Dr. Shanker Dayal Sharma Gold Medal for being the best all-rounder and the Institute Silver Medal for being the department topper. He also holds a B.Tech. in Civil Engineering from the National Institute of Technology (NIT), Warangal, which he completed in May 2001. His strong academic foundation, coupled with his passion for research and innovation, has established him as a leading figure in the field of transportation engineering.

Dr. Amarendra’s professional career is marked by a blend of academic excellence and industry contributions. Over the last five years, he has successfully managed and completed more than 50 consultancy projects as a project manager and team member, ensuring timely delivery and quality outcomes. His technical expertise and ability to work on large-scale infrastructure projects have earned him recognition within the industry. In addition to his research and consultancy work, Dr. Amarendra has been actively involved in mentoring students and guiding them in their academic and professional pursuits. His commitment to education and knowledge-sharing has made him a respected figure among his peers and students.

Dr. Amarendra’s research interests are deeply rooted in transportation engineering, focusing on sustainable and efficient transportation systems. He has authored numerous research papers in high-impact journals and has presented his findings at several national and international conferences. His research work explores the complexities of transportation infrastructure, traffic management, and urban mobility, contributing to the development of innovative solutions to modern transportation challenges. His ability to combine theoretical knowledge with practical applications has made his research highly valuable in the field of civil engineering.

Dr. Amarendra's academic and professional journey is characterized by a relentless pursuit of excellence and a deep commitment to advancing the field of transportation engineering. His exceptional achievements, both in academia and industry, reflect his dedication to fostering innovation and improving transportation systems globally. Through his research, teaching, and consultancy work, Dr. Amarendra continues to inspire the next generation of engineers and researchers, leaving a lasting impact on the academic and professional communities.

sections.heading: Dr. Sk Riyaz Hussain M.Tech, PhD
content: Dr. SK. Riyaz Hussian, M.Tech, Ph.D., is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) at Rajiv Gandhi University of Knowledge Technologies (RGUKT), Nuzvid campus. With over 13 years of academic and research experience, he is recognized for his expertise in communication systems, particularly in wireless and cooperative communication, as well as advanced digital communication techniques

At RGUKT, Dr. Hussian contributes significantly to the ECE department's mission of delivering excellence in electronics and communication engineering education. The department boasts a robust core curriculum complemented by electives in emerging areas, supported by well-equipped experimental facilities and a dedicated technical staff. Dr. Hussian's teaching portfolio includes a diverse range of subjects such as Analog and Digital Communication, Signals and Systems, Electronic Devices and Circuits, Network Theory, Analog Electronics, Electrical Technology, and Computational Science and Engineering using Python. His commitment to integrating practical knowledge with theoretical concepts ensures that students are well-prepared for both academic and industry challenges.

Beyond teaching, Dr. Hussian is actively involved in research, focusing on areas like deep learning applications in communication systems. His dedication to continuous learning and professional development is evident through his participation in various faculty development programs and workshops aimed at enhancing pedagogical skills and staying abreast of technological advancements. As a member of the IEEE, he remains engaged with the global engineering community, contributing to the advancement of knowledge in his field.
Dr. Hussian's blend of academic rigor, research acumen, and commitment to student development makes him a valuable asset to RGUKT and the broader field of electronics and communication engineering.

sections.heading: Mrs. D. Sravani M.Tech
content: Mrs. D. Sravani is an accomplished Assistant Professor in the Department of Civil Engineering at RGUKT-Nuzvid, with over fourteen years of teaching experience. She holds an M.Tech degree and specializes in Hydraulic and Water Resources Engineering, Remote Sensing, and Geographic Information Systems (GIS). Her expertise also extends to Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) applications in agriculture, including field boundary delineation, crop classification, and yield estimation. Throughout her teaching career, Mrs. Sravani has taught a wide range of courses, including Water Resources Engineering, Hydraulic Engineering, Fluid Mechanics, Soil Mechanics, Foundation Engineering, Building Technology, and Construction Management. Her comprehensive understanding of civil engineering fundamentals and emerging technologies has made her a versatile and respected educator.

Mrs. Sravani has actively participated in numerous workshops and training programs to enhance her knowledge and skills. She attended specialized training on GIS Methods for Flood Risk Management at NIT Warangal, Clean Technologies for Sustainable Development in Civil Engineering, and Artificial Intelligence workshops. She also completed an Introduction to Technology Enabled Learning MOOC course and a UGC-sponsored Orientation Programme at Sri Venkateswara University, Tirupati. Her engagement in these programs reflects her commitment to staying updated with the latest advancements in her field and integrating them into her teaching and research.

In addition to her teaching and research contributions, Mrs. Sravani has held several key administrative positions at RGUKT-Nuzvid. She served as the Dean of Academics (FAC) from August 2023 and previously held the same position from February 2021 to August 2022. She was also the Faculty-in-Charge of the Library, Institute Engineer (i/c), and Head of the Department (i/c) at different points in her career. Her leadership roles extended to serving as the Central Course Coordinator for three campuses and as the Joint Coordinator for the Training and Placement Cell. These administrative responsibilities highlight her ability to manage complex academic and institutional functions effectively.

Mrs. Sravani's research work is highly regarded, focusing on GIS-based flood forecast applications, hydrological modeling, and agricultural field boundary delineation using machine learning. Her research has been published in prestigious journals, including Springer and Elsevier, and she has presented at major international conferences. She received the Best Paper Award at the 2nd International Conference on Emerging Trends in Water Resources and Geo-Environmental Engineering. Her contributions to both academic and research fields demonstrate her profound knowledge and innovative approach to solving real-world challenges in civil engineering.

content: Mr. P. Shyam, M.Tech, is an Assistant Professor in the Department of ECE at RGUKT Nuzvid, where he has been serving since June 2012. His expertise includes VLSI Design, FPGA Prototyping, Digital System Design, and IoT applications for healthcare and agriculture. He has taught various subjects, including Architectural Design of IC, Basic Electronics, Digital Logic Design, and Network Theory. He has also attended the UGC-Sponsored Orientation Program at SVU, Tirupati (2017) and the UGC-Sponsored Refresher Course in Computer Science at Andhra University (2018).

Mr. Shyam has received several prestigious awards, including the Silver Award at the Asia Pacific Japan Regional Finals of the InnovateFPGA Global Design Contest (2022) and the Award of Excellence at the InnovateFPGA Design Contest (2019). His research work includes publications in journals and conferences on FPGA-based smart agriculture and IoT. Notable publications include "A Strategical Approach for Implementing Digital Games on FPGA" (2021) and "Smart Irrigation based on Crops using IoT" (2020). He has held key administrative roles, including Administrative Officer (2019–2021), Finance Officer (2016–2018), and Head of the Department (2018–2019, 2022–Present).

sections.heading: About Dean of Consultancy, Research & Development
Dr. Bogala Konda Reddy M.Tech, PhD
content: Dr. Bogala Konda Reddy, M.Tech, Ph.D., is the Head of the Department of Mechanical Engineering at RGUKT RK Valley. He completed his Ph.D. in Heat Transfer from IIT Madras (2010–2013), M.Tech in Thermal Engineering from NIT Warangal (2005–2007), and B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering from JNTU Hyderabad (2000–2004). Before his Ph.D., he worked as an Edison Engineer at General Electric (GE) from 2007 to 2009, where he focused on the design and analysis of motor control centers. He joined RGUKT as a Lecturer in 2013 and became an Assistant Professor in 2016. His research interests include multi-mode and inverse heat transfer, computational methods in engineering, and energy system design and optimization.

Dr. Reddy has authored several high-impact journal articles, including publications in the International Journal of Heat and Mass Transfer and the Journal of Thermal Sciences. He has presented papers at international conferences, including the ISHMT-ASME and the European Thermal Sciences Conference. His research includes projects like the "Design and development of biomass-fired wood gas stoves for rural applications," sponsored by the MHRD, Government of India. Dr. Reddy teaches courses on fluid mechanics, thermodynamics, heat transfer, and power plant engineering. He has held various administrative roles at RGUKT, including Dean of Academics (2016–2018), Associate Dean (2015–2016), and Placement Coordinator (2014–2015). He also assisted Prof. C. Balaji in authoring books and NPTEL lectures on thermal system design and optimization.

sections.heading: Dr. D.V.Nagarjana Devi M.Tech, PhD
content: Dr. D.V. Nagarjana Devi, M.Tech, Ph.D., is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at RGUKT Nuzvid, where she has been working since January 2012. She holds a Diploma in Computer Science and Engineering, a B.Tech in CSE, an M.Tech in CS, and a Ph.D. She has 19 years of teaching and administrative experience, having previously worked at GITAM University, CM Engineering College (Malla Reddy Group), and S.R.K.R Engineering College.

Her teaching areas include C and Data Structures, Data Mining, DBMS, Operating Systems, Distributed Systems, File Structures, Computer Organization, Advanced Unix Programming, and OOP with C++. She has also conducted labs on these subjects.

Dr. Devi has attended several professional development programs, including refresher courses on IoT, AI, and Machine Learning at JNTU Hyderabad and FDPs on AI, Machine Learning, and IoT. She also completed industrial training in Amazon Web Services and Data Analytics Using Tableau.

Her research interests include Sentiment Analysis, Machine Learning, Data Mining, IoT, Artificial Intelligence, and Distributed Systems. She has published research papers in leading journals, such as IJERCSE and IJERA, covering topics like emotion-based music recommendation, sarcasm detection, and web page classification. Her conference presentations include IEEE and Springer events on AI, sentiment analysis, and edge computing.

Dr. Devi has held multiple administrative roles at RGUKT, including Dean of Student Welfare (2016–2019), Finance Officer (2022–present), Training & Placement Officer (2021–2022), and Head of the Department (2014–2015). She has also served as Hostel Warden and Mess Committee Chairman and contributed to student welfare and campus administration.
